description: This file defines a 'BrowseFragment' class for an Android TV application. It sets up a UI for browsing videos in a single row, handles user interactions such as item clicks, and initiates playback via an intent. The class utilizes Leanback library components for TV UI elements.

classes.name: BrowseFragment
classes.description: A Fragment for browsing videos on Android TV, displaying a single row of video cards with navigation and click handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up the title, headers, colors, and calls setup methods.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets the adapter, focus, and view focus behavior after the view is created.

methods.name: setupRows
methods.description: Initializes the row adapter with video items retrieved from VideoCatalog.

methods.name: setupClickListeners
methods.description: Sets up the click event to handle item selection and transition to the PlayerActivity.
